question: In the processing and presentation of peptides of extracellular origin intervene (n):
analysis: Peptides of extracellular origin are typically processed and presented by MHC class II molecules, which involve the HLA-DM molecule in the loading of these peptides onto MHC class II. The TAP proteins and proteasome are more involved in the processing of intracellular peptides for MHC class I presentation. Therefore, the correct option that specifically relates to the processing and presentation of extracellular peptides is HLA-DM.
